subject.title: [Feature Request]: Replace raw textarea with a structured JSON code editor (with folding support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled Control UI code-editor dependency for raw JSON5 config editing, and should that happen by rebuilding the existing open candidate or by asking for a fresh narrow PR?
rationale: The request is aligned with web frontend ergonomics, but it adds a sizeable UI dependency and changes a sensitive config editing surface where maintainer product and compatibility intent should decide the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
options.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only after the implementation is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and save/apply behavior, and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Keep the textarea for now
options.body: Decline the dependency/product surface until raw config editing becomes a higher priority or a lighter existing component is chosen.

options.title: Require a design note first
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a short maintainer design note comparing dependency choice, JSON5 formatting semantics, and sensitive-value handling before code work continues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a rebuilt editor PR
recommendation.body: Accept the CodeMirror-style direction only after the implementation is rebuilt on current main, preserves reveal-to-edit and save/apply behavior, and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied by history to the current reveal-to-edit raw config flow and recent settings/config UI work.
